lastCompletedStory.title: Make journal-append and triage on-main writers ref-only

nextStoryContext: US-003 removes the now-orphaned commitOnMain helper from src/git/on-main.ts (and its tests). Both callers (journal.ts and triage.ts) were converted to commitTreeToMain in US-002; issue-specify.ts callers were converted in US-001. After US-003 the commitOnMain export can be deleted along with its tests. The writeFile? optional on RunTriageOptions and AppendJournalEntryOnMainOptions is retained for backward compat (no callers left, but removing it would be a breaking public API change -- leave for a follow-up).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal git plumbing refactor: no external npm library touched.
